entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I... I think I need to return something? I bought these cycling shoes and they're just not working for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

Oh, um, I don't think they're broken. They just... they give me terrible blisters every time I ride. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but it doesn't help. I'm just so confused by the whole process on the website.

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me pull up our return policy to see what we can do. Can I have your order number please?
Yes, it's VF88602. I got them about a month ago, I think. Is that too late? The website was so overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm happy to help you. Let me see... I have your order from 29 days ago. Okay, I've checked our policy, and I have some good news. Our standard return window is 90 days.
Ninety days? Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can get a refund?
Yes, absolutely. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can process this return for a full refund for the cycling shoes. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label right now.
Wow, thank you so much, Diana! I was so worried I was stuck with them.

It's my pleasure. And I see here that you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, and for the trouble you've had, I'm also adding a 15% discount credit to your account for your next purchase. We want to make sure you find the perfect gear.
That's so nice of you! Thank you! You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. The email with the return label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
